title: Recovery from semantic prediction violations during sentence processing in preschoolers with and without developmental language disorder

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Recovery from semantic prediction violations during sentence processing in preschoolers with and without developmental language disorder》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】The present study investigated graded lexical activation during real-time comprehension of sentences with unexpected endings in preschool-aged children with developmental language disorder (N = 34) and age-matched typically developing (TD) children (N = 41) using a visual-world eye-tracking paradigm.
